title: Install an isolated persistent loopback-only local OverlayKit runtime

claims.statement: Codex is the implementing agent under @rodrigoteamx. The human selected "En este mismo Linux" after the proposal to move from rehearsal to a persistent local production server. This approves bounded implementation and local installation, not acceptance of evidence, public exposure, OBS live-scene mutation, OS-wide trust changes or publication.
claims.evidence: Current model-visible conversation, AGENTS.md and active SPEC-0001 US001/002/008/009/010.

claims.statement: Port8080 is already owned by another service. The default project data/ and server/data directories and dedicated ~/.local/{share,state}/overlaykit-local and ~/.config/overlaykit-local do not exist. The machine has a cached official Caddy2.11.7 image and OBS Flatpak.
claims.evidence: Read-only socket/path inventory, cached Caddy version and image inspect, flatpak list. These facts do not prove that no data exists elsewhere.

claims.statement: The documented secure deployment keeps backend listeners on loopback, uses HTTPS for secure interactive sessions and preserves fragment-only Output credentials plus same-origin WebSocket routing. The existing real-OBS proof is a separate bounded loopback-HTTP sample.

A content-addressed server/frontend release, private fresh data root, persistent user services and a separately pinned proxy can provide a reproducible local deployment without relying on agent terminals or modifying other applications.
claims.evidence: Existing build outputs, single-SQLite authority, deployment guide and ops/local-runtime/discovery.json.

claims.statement: Node24.16.0 and cached Caddy image sha256:f77f856a30f0004200b36b322d61da17fade31e24875699d77fb968399b9eb77 can run the staged release on this Linux host. HTTPS localhost Studio/editor/panel/output and an explicitly localhost-only HTTP Output alias can be verified independently; no public TLS or OBS-TLS claim is made.
claims.evidence: Pinned runtime version/image receipt and required deployment probes.

claims.statement: The human Owner account and real Show/content must be provisioned through the protected Studio; browser trust for the new local certificate and actual OBS configuration are not yet established. The implementation must stop before claiming real production acceptance or mutating an operator live scene.
claims.evidence: SPEC0001 first-run Owner and Output criteria; ADR0038 consumer constraints.

successCriteria.statement: Stage a standalone exact runtime dependency closure and compiled server/frontends in a hashed release. Startup verifies identities; ordinary source edits/builds do not mutate a deployed release. Retain Apache-2.0 and third-party legal metadata.
successCriteria.verification: Release manifest and dependency/source hashes; pack/source-boundary and integrity refusal probes.

successCriteria.statement: Use fresh private production data outside the checkout, preserve all existing data, and compose only one server owner for its SQLite/signing authority. Restarts retain established identity and production state; failures never delete/reset/replace authority.
successCriteria.verification: Ownership/path refusal tests, real-server restart probes and no-overwrite inspection.

successCriteria.statement: Bind backend/proxy services only to loopback on unoccupied ports; keep the existing8080 application intact. Serve interactive surfaces through HTTPS with Secure sessions, exact origins and protected first-run setup. No OS-wide trust installation is automatic.
successCriteria.verification: Socket/TLS/CORS/cookie/first-run probes, actual browser review and service configuration.

successCriteria.statement: Output credentials remain fragment-only and are sent only after WS opens; no operational proxy frame/payload capture. A separate HTTP Output alias is permitted only on loopback and cannot expose interactive API access; it is not LAN/Internet or OBS-TLS evidence.
successCriteria.verification: Proxy routing and request-target tests, actual Output authentication and read-only scope checks.

successCriteria.statement: Prepare persistent local services and rollback before any controller cutover. Bind Companion only after the real Owner issues a least-privilege device credential and separately obtained trust bundle. Preserve the tested USB one-rescan policy.
successCriteria.verification: Service/release receipts, fresh credential/bootstrap/readiness verification and controlled local cutover record.

successCriteria.statement: All enforced checks pass. No accepted ADR/SPEC change, automatic OBS launch/live Program switch, public exposure, Git publication or production acceptance is inferred from installation.
successCriteria.verification: npm run governance:check; npm run check; npm run build; deployment tests; diff and scope inspection.

definitionOfDone.statement: The approved local scope, exact deployment question, actor and claim boundaries precede implementation.
A verified local installation and protected first-run Studio are available with explicit certificate fingerprints, startup behavior, data locations and rollback.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Installed services, release/proxy manifests, TLS and persistence receipts, operating instructions.

definitionOfDone.statement: Human-owned setup and remaining operator/OBS steps are distinguished from automated checks; completion is never claimed while required handoff gates or human setup remain absent.
definitionOfDone.evidence: Bounded final deployment report and observed user setup/configuration outcomes.
